product_summary: Swati Spentose Pvt Ltd (Mumbai HQ; API + intermediate plants at Vapi, Gujarat; finished-dosage Unit 3) is a research-oriented PHARMACEUTICAL company, not a food/FMCG company. Real product lines per own catalogue (swatispentose.com/products): (1) APIs Unit 1 - Pentosan Polysulfate Sodium (flagship, US DMF/CEP), Lidocaine base & HCl, Prilocaine base & HCl, Meloxicam, Melatonin, Granisetron HCl, Tamsulosin, Silodosin, plus pipeline Glycopyrronium Bromide, Mirabegron, Articaine HCl, Tetracaine; (2) APIs Unit 2 - steroids (Dutasteride, Triamcinolone base/acetonide, Halobetasol propionate, Fluocinolone acetonide, Finasteride, Deflazacort, Budesonide, Fluticasone propionate, Clascoterone, Difluprednate) and hormones (Drospirenone, Desogestrel, Dienogest, Ulipristal acetate, Levonorgestrel, Norgestrel, Gestodene, Estradiol hemihydrate, Ethinyl Estradiol, Cyproterone Acetate, Tibolone, Dydrogesterone); (3) Finished dosage Unit 3 - Pentosan Polysulfate capsules 100mg/45mg, intravesical instillation, gel/cream, injection; Melatonin tablets & PR tablets; urology tablets/capsules (Finasteride, Tamsulosin, Dutasteride, Silodosin, Mirabegron, Tolterodine); Glycopyrrolate tablets/solution/roll-on; Lidocaine injection/gel; Phenytoin cream/tablet/injection; Granisetron tablet/injection; (4) OTC/nutraceutical lines - NANO-DECA, Ignite, Varico Gel (Fagus Sylvatica extract), Spento Q10, Sweat Relief, Sleep Ready, Chaga Mushroom Revive Gel, Nonoxynol gel; (5) veterinary division - Pentosan Polysulfate Sodium injections 100mg/ml and 250mg/ml.
role_hint: manufacturer (own API and finished-dosage manufacturing at Vapi, Gujarat; USFDA/EDQM/WHO-GMP filings claimed on own site). No trader signs found in the catalogue.
comment: INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is wrong - the company is a pharma API/formulation manufacturer (own site: 'global research-oriented pharmaceutical company', APIs, steroids, hormones, finished dosage, veterinary). Only the small OTC/nutraceutical tail (Spento Q10, Sleep Ready, Ignite, NANO-DECA) touches food-supplement territory. HS COMPARISON: declared 130219;292429;293329;293339 vs actual - 292429 is CORROBORATED (amide local anaesthetics: Lidocaine, Prilocaine, Articaine, Tetracaine); 293339 is PARTIALLY corroborated (Granisetron, Tamsulosin, Silodosin, Glycopyrronium are heterocyclic amines, though exact subheading per schedule cannot_verify); 293329 is NOT corroborated by any product in the catalogue (no imidazole/phenanthridine line found) - likely a mis-keyed code; 130219 (vegetable saps/extracts, e.g. pentosan-type wood/plant polysaccharide extracts) is PLAUSIBLE for the 'Spentose'/pentosan heritage but NOT corroborated by any customs line - mark 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. MAJOR LINES MISSING FROM DECLARATION: (a) steroids/hormones 2937.2x - the entire Unit 2 steroid+hormone range (Dutasteride, Finasteride, Triamcinolone, Drospirenone, Levonorgestrel, Estradiol, etc.) is absent from the declared codes; (b) finished dosage forms 3004.90 - capsules, tablets, injections, gels, creams, intravesical instillations are absent; (c) veterinary preparations 3002/3004; (d) OTC/cosmetic/nutraceutical lines 3304/3307/2106. RECOMMENDATION per Rule 3: company is KEPT, verdict accepted_hs_corrected - correct the declared set to the actual pharma range (2924.29, 2933.39/2933.49, 2937.23/2937.29, 3004.90, plus 1302.19 only if a customs line confirms the pentosan extract). All product identifications above come from the company's own catalogue page (https://swatispentose.com/products) and company page (https://swatispentose.com/company/) - i.e. 'заявлено, не подтверждено' until matched against a customs/B-L line; no shipment records were researched per role scope.
